extracted.intended_audience: scholars and researchers in communication, media studies, and journalism (especially new media/Instagram-focused research)
extracted.subtask_description: A research study analysing how traditional news values are reconfigured on Instagram and proposing the concept of 'insta-worthiness' to capture platform-specific components of newsworthiness; uses a three-step content analysis of three high-circulation Turkish newspapers over one month.

rubrics_metrics.name: Insta‑worthiness (proposed)
rubrics_metrics.description: A new term — insta-worthiness — is suggested in this study to clarify the main components of news values on Instagram.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The paper proposes 'insta-worthiness' as a concept capturing how news values operate specifically on Instagram; details of its components are derived from the study's findings (not all components listed in the abstract).

rubrics_metrics.name: Engagement metrics as components of newsworthiness
rubrics_metrics.description: Concepts such as share, like, comment, etc. have become significant for news values and newsworthiness in [the] digital age.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The study treats platform engagement indicators (shares, likes, comments) as salient determinants of what is considered newsworthy on social media platforms like Instagram.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reconstruction of traditional news values
rubrics_metrics.description: Traditional understanding of news values and newsworthiness has been reconstructed within this period [of Web 2.0 and social media].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The paper frames changes to news values as a reconfiguration rather than a simple replacement, implying that classic criteria (e.g., timeliness, proximity, impact) are being reinterpreted in light of social media affordances and audience behaviour.

rubrics_metrics.name: Platform affordances and social media as a news environment
rubrics_metrics.description: Social media has emerged as an alternative or a developed version of traditional media; social media is an effective platform for information and news sharing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The study treats the technological and social affordances of Instagram (as a social media platform) as materially shaping what counts as news; producers and audiences interact with these affordances to produce distinctive news values on the platform.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of content analysis (three-step) for assessing Insta‑worthiness
rubrics_metrics.description: Content analysis was selected as research technique. Based on research questions, three-step analysis was conducted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Methodological guidance: the paper uses a systematic content-analysis approach (three-step procedure) applied to posts from three highest-circulation Turkish newspapers over a one-month period to identify components of Instagram-specific news values.
